_comment: Copy this file to profiles/<yoursite>.json and fill in real values. Every field here is required.
name: Example App
viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1, minimum-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover
_webRoot_comment: Optional. DUMMY PATH - replace with your site's public/static folder (Next.js: <project>/public) or leave empty. If set and it exists, build/gen-web copies twa-mobile.js there and merges the manifest patch. Leave webHtml [] for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Remix and other frameworks (put the snippet in your layout instead, see RUN.md 4c); use e.g. ["index.html"] only for plain static HTML sites. Leave webManifestPath empty unless your manifest is not public/manifest.json or public/manifest.webmanifest.

signingKey.dn: CN=Example App, OU=Engineering, O=Example Inc, L=City, S=State, C=US

_playSigningFingerprint_comment: Once this app is published and Play App Signing is enabled, get the 'App signing key certificate' SHA-256 fingerprint from Play Console -> Protected with Play -> Play Store protection -> Manage Play app signing, and paste it below. Without this, npm run gen-assetlinks will only emit your local upload-key fingerprint, and the TWA will show the browser URL bar for every user who installed from the Play Store.
